def process(s: str) -> str:
    res = []
    n = len(s)
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if i != 0 and i != n - 3 and s[i:i+3] == "dot":
            res.append('.')
            i += 3
        elif i != 0 and i != n - 2 and s[i:i+2] == "at":
            res.append('@')
            i += 2
            res.extend(s[i:])
            break
        else:
            res.append(s[i])
            i += 1
    return ''.join(res)

def main() -> None:
    input_str = input().strip()
    print(process(input_str))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
